text: 中国7月份汽油出口42万吨，同比降55.3%；1-7月累计汽油出口172万吨，同比降64.4%。 7月份柴油出口81万吨，同比降0.4%；1-7月累计柴油出口353万吨，同比降2.8%。 7月份成品油进口248万吨，同比降38.5%；1-7月累计成品油进口1,991万吨，同比降14.9%。 7月份石脑油进口121万吨，同比降29%；1-7月累计石脑油进口770万吨，同比降16.8%。 7月份航空煤油进口0万吨，同比增12.2%；1-7月累计航空煤油进口4万吨，同比降81%。 7月份液化天然气进口550万吨，同比增2.4%；1-7月累计液化天然气进口3,3
text_en: China's July gasoline exports totaled 420,000 tons, down 55.3% year-on-year; cumulative January-July exports were 1.72 million tons, down 64.4%. July diesel exports were 810,000 tons, down 0.4%; cumulative January-July exports were 3.53 million tons, down 2.8%. July refined oil product imports were 2.48 million tons, down 38.5%; cumulative January-July imports were 19.91 million tons, down 14.9%. July naphtha imports were 1.21 million tons, down 29%; cumulative January-July imports were 7.7 million tons, down 16.8%.
